title: Promises/A+ Compliant Promise Implementation from Scratch
whatThisCodeCovers: Constructs a robust, production-grade custom Promise class implementing the Promises/A+ specification with microtask-based deferred resolution, state transitions, chaining unwrapping, and error bubbling.

breakdown.note: Defines the 3 immutable state constants: PENDING, FULFILLED, and REJECTED.
The resolve function: locks state to FULFILLED and triggers handlers unless value is a promise.
The .then() method returns a new MyPromise, registering callbacks into the handlers queue.
Executes handlers inside queueMicrotask to ensure asynchronous execution per the Promises/A+ spec.

customPromiseAllSettled: waits for all items using finally, returning status/value/reason objects.

The enqueue function returns a Promise and adds the task to the queue.

breakdown.note: Configures retry budget: maxRetries, initialDelayMs, factor, and maxDelayMs ceiling.
Computes exponential backoff and applies random jitter: Math.random() * calculatedBackoff.
Retries the flaky network call until it succeeds on attempt 3.
